name: issue-to-pr
description: Take a GitHub issue (bare, or tracked on a Project board) from triage to a merge-ready PR through a gated, worktree-isolated pipeline that scales its depth to the task and asks at most one batched question. The gates hold every run: design hardening, tests green, code review clean. Once you approve the PR in-session it merges, preferring a squash and falling back to whatever the repository allows, then tears down the branch and worktree; a merge into anything but the default branch is reported as one, since that is where the issue's auto-close depends. The board card advances as work moves.
